title: RuMampu · App data (local copy)
description: Totals and daily activity from a local snapshot of the RuMampu database.

options.content:
### RuMampu app data (local copy)
Reads a snapshot of `backend/db.sqlite3` taken by `refresh-db.sh`, never Neon. Only totals and counts are shown. Local data comes from test runs and sample scenarios, so it is not real user behaviour.

panels.description: Every guest or account profile in the snapshot.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM finance_guestprofile

panels.title: New profiles per day
panels.description: Guests created and accounts signed up each day.

targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT date(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours') UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < date(${__to:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours')), counts AS (SELECT date(created_at, '+8 hours') AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM finance_guestprofile WHERE created_at >= datetime(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '-8 hours') GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', days.d) AS INTEGER) - 28800 AS time, COALESCE(counts.n, 0) AS "New guests" FROM days LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.d = days.d ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT date(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours') UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < date(${__to:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours')), counts AS (SELECT date(created_at, '+8 hours') AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM finance_guestprofile WHERE created_at >= datetime(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '-8 hours') GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', days.d) AS INTEGER) - 28800 AS time, COALESCE(counts.n, 0) AS "New guests" FROM days LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.d = days.d ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (SELECT date(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours') UNION ALL SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < date(${__to:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '+8 hours')), counts AS (SELECT date(date_joined, '+8 hours') AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM auth_user WHERE date_joined >= datetime(${__from:date:seconds}, 'unixepoch', '-8 hours') AND is_superuser = 0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', days.d) AS INTEGER) - 28800 AS time, COALESCE(counts.n, 0) AS "New accounts" FROM days LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.d = days.d ORDER BY 1
